title: The Sundowner | Designer Pet Friendly Villa | Exclusive 30A
meta_description: The Sundowner offers panoramic Gulf views, a private pool, elevator, bikes, and designer interiors just 10 yards from the beach near Thomas Donuts.
description_expanded: The Sundowner Panoramic Gulf-front Living Steps from the Sand and next to Thomas Donuts Home Introduction Experience elevated coastal living at The Sundowner , a beautifully designed four bedroom retreat with sweeping Gulf views from every level. The home is a vacation for all your senses, thanks to the decadent aromas calling from next door Thomas Donuts. Featuring a private pool, elevator access, and multiple indoor and outdoor living spaces , this home offers the perfect blend of luxury and location just steps from the beach . Home Highlights · Panoramic Gulf Views - Enjoy stunning water views from every floor · Private Pool - Heated October through April for an additional fee · Beach Access - Just steps from the sand · Private Elevator - Access to all floors with signed waiver required · Outdoor Living - Pool deck with lounge seating, umbrella, propane grill, and cabana bath · 4 Taxi Bikes - Perfect for exploring the surrounding area · Pet Friendly - Up to 2 dogs, 60 pounds or less, allowed with approval and non-refundable fee · Flexible Stays - No Saturday-to-Saturday requirement during summer · Parking for 4 Vehicles - Driveway parking available (garage access not available) · Gourmet Kitchen - Italian stainless appliances, 8 burner range, wine chiller, ice maker, and coffee options · Multiple Living Spaces - Gulf-facing living room and second floor family room · Dining for 14 - Seating for 10 plus breakfast bar seating for 4 · Laundry Rooms - Located on second and third floors · Whole Home WiFi - Includes printer for remote work or school needs · Smart Home Security - Exterior camera overlooking rear grounds beyond pool deck Location Perks · Steps to Beach Access - Just a short walk to the shoreline · Next to Thomas Donuts - Convenient access to a local favorite. Free Smells! · 9 minute drive to Pier Park - Shopping, dining, entertainment, and attractions · 12 minute drive to Rosemary Beach and Inlet Beach - Upscale Dining, shopping, and coastal charm Know Before You Go · A mid-stay clean is required for bookings of 10 days or longer and is included in your reservation · Additional mid-stay cleans can be scheduled for an additional fee · Elevator access requires a signed waiver and is intended for adult use only · Nearby beach access does not allow dogs; a designated dog-friendly beach is located less than 10 minutes away The Sundowner delivers a complete beachside experience with designer interiors, spacious gathering areas, and unbeatable proximity to the Gulf. Enjoy morning coffee with Gulf views, afternoons by the private pool, and evenings surrounded by the sights and sounds of the coast. This is coastal living at its finest. ***Pets are welcome with prior approval by Exclusive 30A. Please request your pet’s stay at time of reservation. Payment of our non-refundable pet fee must be paid at time of approval.***
rooms_guidance: 2nd Floor King Suite 1 | Gulf View from bed, private entrance to Gulf Facing Balcony, TV, dresser storage and large walk-in closet with stacked washer/dryer, ensuite bath with dual vanity sink and walk-in shower with rain and handheld shower heads

2nd Floor Bunk Room 1 | Queen over King Bunk (sleeps 4). built-in ladder and guard rail on top bunk, private reading lights for each bed, view of pool area, reach-in closet storage, TV, shared Jack and Jill Bath with dual vanity sink and combination shower/tub

2nd Floor Bunk Room 2 | Two Twin over Full Bunks (Sleeps 6). built-in ladder and guard rail on top bunks, private reading lights for each bed, view of pool area, reach-in closet storage, TV, shared Jack and Jill Bath with dual vanity sink and combination shower/tub

3rd Floor King Suite 2 | TV, walk-in closet (additional washer and dryer in closet) and dresser storage, ensuite spa bath with jetted soaking tub, double vanity sink, and walk-in shower featuring rain and handheld shower heads, private water closet
Exterior Cabana Bath | Powder Room with outdoor access from private pool area

Accessibility: Path to Entrance Lit at Night
Property Amenities: Path to Entrance Lit at Night
